meta.title: After the end is pulled in, a vendor cannot bid
meta.source: llm-fast (read-back removed after a false live failure)
warnings: 2026-10-04: the model's read-back (round status equals closed) was removed — the case does not state it, and the round reads 'active' during its extra closing time; it made a live run fail falsely on two fresh events.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer pulls the end in to 90 seconds from now.
Wait until the pulled-in bid end passes.
QA vendor tries to place a bid after the pulled-in end.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that “status” equals closed.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Order not active”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals closed.
